case.summary: Case AC-HHF-001 is evaluated as fraud with 0.92 probability under an undocumented coordinated pattern involving a three-transaction online episode (3660106, 3660107, 3660108) totaling $2,189.02 in exposure. The decisive signal is a series of ProductCD C online purchases using New mobile profiles behind IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS that match telemetry on 13 peer cards and sharply exceed the card's $134.93 prior median amount. A block of card C05061-K1 is recommended awaiting L1 approval, and filing a SAR is recommended awaiting L2 approval.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is submitted to document an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern identified under internal case reference AC-HHF-001. The primary subjects are customer C05061, credit card C05061-K1, device profiles RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | NULL and RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for tablet | 1920x1080, and connected cards C00450-K1, C02342-K1, C05704-K2, C05770-K1, C06220-K1, C06962-K2, C07212-K2, C07925-K1, C07997-K1, C09251-K1, C10553-K1, C11309-K1, and C11543-K2. On 2017-01-12 at 07:08, an online purchase of $850.28 (id 3660106) for product code C was conducted in billing region 492.0 using device profile RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | NULL. On 2017-01-13 at 22:09, a second online purchase of $890.79 (id 3660107) for product code C was conducted in billing region 264.0 using device profile RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for tablet | 1920x1080. On 2017-01-14 at 20:25, a third online purchase of $447.95 (id 3660108) for product code C was conducted in billing region 492.0 using device profile RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | NULL. The transactions form a coordinated anonymous-proxy mobile wave across 14 cards sharing product code C and proxy telemetry, representing a sharp departure from the cardholder's baseline prior median transaction amount of $134.93 across 119 prior transactions as of opening. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card (4 earlier closed case(s), none reported); closed cases CC-3791 on the same device profile or connected cards were confirmed fraud with reports filed. OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. The case was opened 2017-01-15, where monitoring of connected cards was executed and the case was escalated to an analyst; a block of card C05061-K1 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this report filing is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval, covering a total suspicious amount of $2,189.02.
